title: First-frame EgoDex tabletop in Isaac with YAM
source_license: CC-by-NC-ND, see ATTRIBUTION.txt and official dataset repository
method: Manual contours and camera ray / horizontal plane intersection, scaled by assumed 20cm plate; approximate 3D primitives and extruded silhouettes
controller: Scripted smooth Cartesian waypoints via URDF IK and physical joint drives
source_aligned_image: Robot hidden for initial-layout comparison only. Task video shows robot and physical object interaction.
open_scene: Open isaac_scene.usdc in Isaac Sim 5.1; press Play to hold the initial pose. Running the full task requires the local real_to_sim_pick.py script.
limitations: One nominal rollout; no robustness evaluation.
Dimensions, heights, materials, collisions and drive dynamics are approximate.
Sponge texture, beam holes and human hands not reconstructed.
